segments.text: And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders,
And spake unto him, saying,

segments.speaker: Chief Priests and Scribes
segments.text: Tell us, by what authority doest thou these things? or who is he that gave thee this authority?
And he answered and said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: I will also ask you one thing; and answer me:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men?
And they reasoned with themselves, saying,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed ye him not?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet.
And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was.
And Jesus said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things.
Then began he to speak to the people this parable;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and entreated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others.
And when they heard it, they said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: God forbid.
And he beheld them, and said,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder.
¶ And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them.

And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor.
And they asked him, saying, Master,

segments.speaker: The people
segments.text: we know that thou sayest and teachest rightly, neither acceptest thou the person of any, but teachest the way of God truly:

segments.speaker: Spies
segments.text: Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Cæsar, or no?
But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt ye me?

segments.speaker: Spies
segments.text: Shew me a penny. Whose image and superscription hath it?
They answered and said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Cæsar’s.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Render therefore unto Cæsar the things which be Cæsar’s, and unto God the things which be God’s.
And they could not take hold of his words before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace.
¶ Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him,
Saying,

segments.speaker: The Sadducees
segments.text: Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man’s brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother.

segments.speaker: The Sadducees
segments.text: There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children.

segments.speaker: The Sadducees
segments.text: And the second took her to wife, and he died childless.

segments.speaker: The Sadducees
segments.text: And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died.

segments.speaker: The Sadducees
segments.text: Last of all the woman died also.

segments.speaker: The Sadducees
segments.text: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife.
And Jesus answering said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage:

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Now that the dead are raised, even Moses shewed at the bush, when he calleth the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him.
¶ Then certain of the scribes answering said,

segments.speaker: The scribes
segments.text: Master, thou hast well said.
And after that they durst not ask him any question at all.
And he said unto them,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: How say they that Christ is David’s son?

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: And David himself saith in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou on my right hand,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Till I make thine enemies thy footstool.
David therefore calleth him Lord, how is he then his son?
¶ Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples,

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts;

segments.speaker: Jesus
segments.text: Which devour widows’ houses, and for a shew make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.
